sentences.text: 1  BLAPL No.1726 of 2021 04. 04.06.2021 The matter is taken up through video conferencing.

Heard Mr. D. Nayak, learned senior counsel appearing  on behalf of the Petitioner and Mr. K. Gaya, learned Addl.
 Standing Counsel for Opposite Party - State.

This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for  grant of bail to the Petitioner Trilochan Sahoo @ Tilia in  connection with Malgodown P.S. Case No.222 of 2020  corresponding to G.R. Case No.1346 of 2020 pending in  the court of learned J.M.F.C.(City), Cuttack for alleged  commission of offence under Sections 420/272/273/34  of the Indian Penal Code, read with Section  51/52/56/57/59/63 of Food Safety and Standards Act,
 2006 and Section 16 of the Prevention of Food  Adulteration Act.
It is submitted that the allegations are relating to  preparation of adulterated chili powder and turmeric  powder and the Petitioner is inside custody since 2nd  February, 2021.
It is also submitted that in the meantime  investigation has been completed and the Petitioner being  a permanent resident under Purighat P.S., there is no  chance of his absconding.
After hearing learned State counsel and considering  the fact of completion of investigation as well as the  circumstances of the case

, it is directed to release the  Petitioner on bail in the aforesaid case on such terms and  conditions to be fixed by the learned court in seisin over  2  the matter including the condition that, he shall not be  involved in any other offence while on bail and shall  appear before the trial court on each date fixed.
The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
